build_kitti_dataset_builder: build a tfds GeneratorBasedBuilder for the KITTI dataset with image and object annotation features
parse_kitti_annotations: parse KITTI annotation text files into a list of object dictionaries with type, bbox, dimensions, and location
build_bounding_box: build a TFDS BBox from raw KITTI pixel coordinates normalized to image dimensions
build_kitti_splits: split KITTI training images into train, validation, and test sets by video while keeping video frames together
generate_kitti_examples: generate tfds examples yielding images with annotated objects for train, validation, or test splits
